team_history: Canonical play-by-play completed regular-season games only, 2021-2025 league priors and 2026 weeks 1-5 current offense/defense; no target outcomes
opponent_rule: Equal logit blend of shrunk offense and opposing allowed event rates; equal mean blend for play volume and yard efficiency. Fixed transparent defaults; no claim of optimized or calibrated effects.
volume: Shared game pace factor; nonnegative integer team plays partition into pass plays and rushing attempts; sacks remove throws; targeted attempts and non-targeted throws are separate.
allocation: Current observed team, reserve/injury gates, fresh depth-chart order, historical recent snaps and B1 component weights. QB starter receives pass budget; supported backup change is a scenario alternative, not additive. Unsupported offensive roles and mean opportunities below 0.1 are excluded before normalization; removed opportunities are redistributed.
injuries: Fresh provider catalog and official game status where captured; OUT excludes first target only; reserve/IR/PUP/suspension labels exclude horizon under explicit static assumption. Questionable/Doubtful retained as uncertainty without invented medical probabilities. No unproven return date. No unquantified individual opponent injury multiplier.
coherence: Same completed pass creates passer completion and receiver reception/yard/TD credits. Same interception/sack creates offense and opposing defense/IDP credits. Player totals aggregate to shared team ledgers in every draw. Kick scoring follows TD/drive-derived opportunities. All enabled existing score outputs retained.
yard_threshold: No independent internal yard cutoff; raw sub-one-yard expectations preserved to maintain accounting. Opportunity threshold applied before allocation; no rare-TD/INT cutoff.
specialists: Existing source-bound B1 rates for specialist events; team/IDP credits reconciled by declared unit scope. Return counts bounded by opposing available kicks/punts; special-team TDs bounded by return/block opportunities. Special-team forced/recovered fumbles, blocked-kick return yards and field-goal return yards use explicit zero prediction defaults until a unit-attributed event owner exists; these are model assumptions, not source-observed zeros. Tackle opportunities use opposing play budgets and historical tackle/assist event rates with a two-assist approximation. Some rare marginal rates remain heuristic; uncalibrated distribution and no fully sequential drive simulator.
evaluation: Original forecasts immutable; no current outcomes/heldout selection used to tune revision. Accounting and availability independently replayed; current mean and per-draw identities checked; historical-range plausibility and unsupported-source statuses exported.
